question: Do the deterministic semantic-rule variables discovered through E017 improve Lift@10% over the canonical E016 ABT at T1/T2?
hypothesis: Adding the compact Rules-only semantic sidecar increases macro Lift@10% across T1/T2 without material degradation in average precision.
primary_change: add deterministic E017 semantic rule sidecar features to the E016 T1/T2 feature sets

scoring_time.timestamp_definition: same E016 score_time; T1=first inquiry_at, T2=second+ inquiry_at before conversion

target.censoring: same E016 right-censoring and ambiguous-label exclusion

exclusions: T0 because no Spot exists at scoring time

validation.strategy: 4-fold expanding-window chronological lead-cohort CV with paired OOF comparison
validation.split_description: same fold boundaries for baseline and semantic_rules; test cohorts are disjoint and grouped by lead

decision_rule.supported: macro delta Lift@10% 95% paired-bootstrap CI > 0 and macro AP delta >= -0.001
decision_rule.inconclusive: positive point lift but interval crosses zero
decision_rule.not_supported: non-positive macro lift with bootstrap P(delta>0) < 0.50

items.evidence: No inquiry outcome or future event is used. Candidate data does not provide historical versions of listing copy/attributes, so production point-in-time semantics require confirmation.
